projects.title: We came
projects.description:
Speed ​​Taxi – Go wherever you want! 

A super fast kangaroo that compliments you in every taxi? 
Yes, we are responsible for this finding too!
Speed ​​Taxi is one of the nicest clients we have and yes, we admit that we enjoy working.

data.content: A super-fast kangaroo that compliments you in every taxi? We made it happen.
Speed Taxi is a modern, fast taxi service that operates through a mobile app, where you can book a ride in just a few clicks and get a licensed taxi in minutes.
We gave Speed a distinctive update in its logo and mascot-the kangaroo, which is now seen all over Tirana and Durrës. We made sure the kangaroo is friendly, a little cheeky, yet always sweet.
Inside every taxi partnered with Speed, we placed fun phrases to motivate passengers to take a ride and go wherever they want in maximum comfort.
Some of the sayings we created include: " Who left you on foot, superstar?", "Where to?", "You make me come in 3 minutes".
Speed continues to be just as charming on social media, which also showcases the advantages of using the app and our unwavering dedication to this client.
